title: Subscription Billing & Stripe Webhook Integration
learningObjectives: Implement secure Stripe Checkout and Customer Portal redirects
Process asynchronous subscription lifecycle events via webhooks
Handle invoice payment failures, dunning emails, and grace periods
keyTradeoffs: Hosted checkout sessions vs custom in-app credit card elements (PCI compliance)
Immediate access grant vs waiting for webhook confirmation
commonPitfalls: Trusting client-side payment completion redirects without verifying signed webhooks
Failing to handle out-of-order webhook delivery (e.g. invoice created after subscription deleted)
transferPrompt: How do you record external Stripe payment charges into an internal double-entry ledger?
